assertions.description: PerformanceResourceTiming exists (the surface whose classification this feature changes).
PerformanceResourceTiming.prototype exposes contentType, the minimized-MIME-type observable (Chrome 148+).
A real same-origin response served as text/example+xml minimizes to application/xml — the core of the spec rule: any valid MIME type whose subtype ends in +xml is an XML MIME type.
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof PerformanceResourceTiming !== 'function' || !('contentType' in PerformanceResourceTiming.prototype)) return false; const rel = '/v158/spec-compliant-xml-mime-type-detection/serve?type=' + encodeURIComponent('text/example+xml') + '&cachebust=' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const abs = new URL(rel, location.href).href; const res = await fetch(rel, { cache: 'no-store' }); await res.text(); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const [e] = performance.getEntriesByName(abs); if (e) return e.contentType === 'application/xml'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); } return false; })()

assertions.description: A response served as image/example+xml also minimizes to application/xml — the rule covers every valid top-level type, not just application/*.

assertions.description: application/example+xml minimizes to application/xml — the half of the suffix rule Chrome applied all along; a regression here would be worse than the old behaviour.

assertions.description: image/svg+xml does NOT minimize to application/xml: minimize-a-supported-MIME-type returns the essence for SVG, the deliberate exception to the +xml rule.
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof PerformanceResourceTiming !== 'function' || !('contentType' in PerformanceResourceTiming.prototype)) return false; const rel = '/v158/spec-compliant-xml-mime-type-detection/serve?type=' + encodeURIComponent('image/svg+xml') + '&cachebust=' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const abs = new URL(rel, location.href).href; const res = await fetch(rel, { cache: 'no-store' }); await res.text(); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const [e] = performance.getEntriesByName(abs); if (e) return e.contentType === 'image/svg+xml'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); } return false; })()

assertions.description: text/plain does not become application/xml — guards against an over-broad implementation that would sweep non-+xml types into the XML bucket.
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof PerformanceResourceTiming !== 'function' || !('contentType' in PerformanceResourceTiming.prototype)) return false; const rel = '/v158/spec-compliant-xml-mime-type-detection/serve?type=' + encodeURIComponent('text/plain') + '&cachebust=' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const abs = new URL(rel, location.href).href; const res = await fetch(rel, { cache: 'no-store' }); await res.text(); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const [e] = performance.getEntriesByName(abs); if (e) return e.contentType !== 'application/xml'; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); } return false; })()
